name: Chốt baseline thiết kế và điều kiện làm việc (rolling wave)

owners.BE: BE01 — 1 backend; coordination assignment, actual human logs receipt/start
owners.FE: FE01 — 1 frontend; coordination assignment, actual human logs receipt/start
owners.QA: QA01 — 1 tester; coordination assignment, actual human logs receipt/start

paths.BE: Chỉ đọc app/warehouse-api/src và app/warehouse-api/src/migrations; contract đề xuất ghi trong task (mới, đề xuất).
paths.FE: Chỉ đọc app/warehouse-ui/src; screen map/wireflow đề xuất ghi trong task (mới, đề xuất).
paths.QA: Test strategy, test basis và ma trận vai trò trong .agents/tasks/<task-id>/ (mới, đề xuất); không ghi DB.

scope.BE: Chốt typed contract, quyền, dữ liệu và migration policy.
scope.FE: Chốt screen/action/state và wireframe theo Ant Design.
scope.QA: Chốt test basis, fixture và target test riêng; chưa chạy QA ứng dụng.

entry: All linked R2 decisions + W00 design gate; task dependencies in planning/plan.json. W01 may start now; subsequent implementation waits upstream QA closure. No further business choice is required for current phase.
handoff: Changed paths with exact SHA/diff and migration IDs, excluding others WIP
Actual command, runtime, environment ID, results and defect/case IDs
Contract/API/FE parity and negative cases; DB and browser evidence at required level
No OPEN design deviation: create CR before changing approved behavior
exit: Role tasks COMPLETE with evidence; QA real-level results, independent code review and owner acceptance before package ACCEPTED. Current no-review request applies to preparing this decision pack, not fabrication of future review results.
